$comment: Implementation status and evidence stay in parity.json. This file defines assessment coverage and records actual acceptance separately. The generated matrix includes every ledger item through desktop-plan.json, including the whole personal/work suite. SDK availability or CI compilation is not a device pass. Old web exclusions require review against the own web client.

checks: Exchange encrypted messages in both directions between clients in a DM and a group.
Reply and navigate to the original; edit and delete an own sent message; check permissions and remote updates.
Add/remove each quick reaction and an emoji from the picker; check counts, own selection, sender names and long joined emoji.
Check typing privacy and timeout. Disconnect/reconnect; cancel and retry an actual failed send without duplication.
Send, receive, view/play and save each media kind in both directions, including encrypted media and a caption.
Check image animation, video sound, file name/type, voice recording/playback, cancellation, failure/retry and permission denial.
Confirm a video message does not count as a video call, and voice playback does not count as voice recording.
Start and answer audio and video calls in both directions; join/leave a group call and check participant/key changes.
Decline, time out and miss a call; check the timeline and incoming attention while foreground, background, locked, asleep, window closed and after quit. Record unsupported states explicitly.
Mute/unmute, camera on/off, switch microphone, speaker, camera and Bluetooth devices; test denied/revoked permissions.
Reconnect after network loss, wake and blocked UDP; verify E2EE and Bipe SFU/TURN routing.
Use personal and work accounts; switching accounts cannot leak a call, permission or notification.
Test sender and receiver support separately, with exact OS capture permissions.
Choose a screen/window/app, start/stop and revoke permission; check remote visibility, source closure, reconnect and E2EE.
Compare palette/background labels, order, defaults and selected state on every client; restart and check persistence, dark mode and high contrast.
Compare the three modes, account-switcher position, unread indicators, favourite ordering and group/DM avatars.
Test personal and work accounts, switching, relaunch, phone offline and remote revocation.
